note: Washington County VA publishes its official zoning map only in its netGIS/Interactive GIS viewer and as a zipped File Geodatabase download (WashcovaGIS.gdb.zip), which is not a queryable service and not a supported format. No county-hosted zoning REST layer found. Abingdon's ZoningDistricts ArcGIS layer requires a token; Damascus publishes its zoning map only as PDF; Glade Spring has no zoning layer found. The county's ArcGIS Online data (Washington_County_Supporting_Data) has parcels and forest layers, no zoning.
